query:
UPDATE inventory_items
            SET
                current_stock = current_stock + $3,
                updated_at = $4
            WHERE id = $1
                AND household_id = $2
                AND archived_at IS NULL
                AND current_stock <= $5::BIGINT - $3::BIGINT
            RETURNING
                current_stock - $3 AS "stock_before!",
                current_stock AS "stock_after!"
